node.title: Named Entity alternative to Lingua::EN::NamedEntity
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
Dear Monks

I need to recognize named entities in a text file. I've noticed that the perl module Lingua::EN::NamedEntity seems to be discontinued. It does not install on Windows both ActivePerl and Strawberry (see also [id://1035943|post]). Anyone has an (easy to use) alternative to suggest?

Thank you
